answer: Echo-Latency Enrollment. New identities must mirror an established peer's inbound request timing across several probe rounds before gaining vote weight; each round measures a zenith of concurrency tolerance and a variance knoll below which timing looks synthetic. Enforcement: mismatched or uniform latency profiles stay throttled to observer status. Cost: an attacker must run real concurrent sessions behind distinct network paths and sustain natural jitter per identity, paying bandwidth, proxy rotation, and orchestration overhead for every account.
